title: Continuation Study With Oral MC-1 for Treatment of Patients With PNPO-Deficiency
official: Open-Label Continuation Treatment Study With Oral MC-1 for the Treatment of Patients With PNPO Deficiency
summary: Continued access to MC-1 is required by subjects who have participated in the MEND-PNPO study, as no other pharmaceutical grade P5P is currently commercially available. The protocol duration is planned for until the finished product is commercially available in the respective countries where subjects are participating in the study.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The subject should have completed participation in the MEND-PNPO study (Protocol # 16002) and in the opinion of the Principal Investigator would benefit from long-term treatment with MC-1
* Written informed consent (by parent or guardian if under the age of 18)

Exclusion Criteria:

* The patient has any condition or abnormality which may, in the opinion of the Investigator, compromise the safety of the patient, or influence their ability to comply with study procedures.
